summary: The start is a gate the field hides: the platform's only ways on are a ridge pump (the WR) or a duck-jump climb at its NW corner onto a north ledge (~1e-4 per random 8 s burst). Arms 1-4 (sidistic warm start; plain energy pot; time-pen 0; respawn-speed 1.0-1.6) all stall at that corner (0.07-0.45); time-pen 0.001 makes suicide the attractor there. Go-Explore phase 1 from the map start (explore_phase1, NEW --maxvel/--view-velocity) gets off the platform in 2.5 min (3.2%). Arm 5 (running): recipe + time-pen 0 + --spawn-states from the Go-Explore archive, warm from the sidistic transfer.
